SELECT * FROM arte_ai_tool WHERE provider_id = #{providerId} ORDER BY namespace, name
SELECT * FROM arte_ai_tool WHERE tool_id = #{toolId} LIMIT 1

where.if: AND (namespace LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT t.tool_id, t.namespace, t.name, t.provider_id, t.title, t.description, COALESCE(t.latest_version, (SELECT v.version FROM arte_ai_tool_version v WHERE v.tool_id = t.tool_id ORDER BY v.create_time DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS latest_version, t.lifecycle_state, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM arte_ai_tool_version v WHERE v.tool_id = t.tool_id) AS version_count, t.update_time FROM arte_ai_tool t
ORDER BY t.update_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
